name: autostand-e2e
description: Playwright E2E specs for the autostand app UI, driven against a mocked Tauri IPC backend.
//: type=commonjs makes this directory a CommonJS island. The repo root is type=module, so Playwright would treat these specs as ESM — and ESM resolution cannot follow the tsconfig `paths` bridge into apps/autostand-app/node_modules. Compiled to CJS they require the real packages instead.
